bio: One of the first Titans ever Invoked by the Cambion, Hamaga carries all the madness and fury of their Demonic ancestors – and all the power that those ancestors once turned against the people of Amara. Now, Hamaga's cruel blades are saved only for the defense of the Broken Reach.
